description: Source code for VertexAIApi class implementing interactions with Google Vertex AI and related models, including authentication setup, request handling, streaming, and model management.

classes.name: VertexAIApi
classes.description: Class implementing API interactions with Google Vertex AI, supporting various models, authentication, streaming, and error handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes VertexAIApi instance with configuration, sets up authentication, and sub-instances.

methods.name: setupAuthentication
methods.description: Configures authentication client based on provided credentials or environment.

methods.name: getApiBase
methods.description: Returns the base URL for API requests depending on configuration.

methods.name: determineVertexProvider
methods.description: Identifies the provider type (mistral, anthropic, gemini, unknown) based on model name.

methods.name: getAuthHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves authorization headers, using API key or OAuth token.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs full URL for API endpoints with query parameters.

methods.name: convertAnthropicBody
methods.description: Converts request body to Anthropic-specific format.

methods.name: convertGeminiBody
methods.description: Converts request body to Gemini-specific format.

methods.name: chatCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Performs non-streaming chat completion request, handling different providers.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Performs streaming chat completion, yielding chunks.

methods.name: fimStream
methods.description: Streams FIM (Fill-In-Mask) responses for Codestral models.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Throws error; model listing not supported.
